title: General.
officialText:
Buildings shall be provided with natural ventilation in accordance with Section 1203.4, and/or mechanical
ventilation in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code. All habitable spaces shall be provided with natural ventilation
in accordance with Section 1203.4.
